description: Suriname's Algemeen Bureau voor de Statistiek (ABS) published the results of the eighth General Population Census of 2012 in thematic volumes. Volume 3 on households, dwellings and environment tabulates dwellings by main source of lighting and electricity supply, separating the EBS utility grid, government supply in the interior, supply from neighbours, own generators and solar, and dwellings by water supply and by the utility delivering piped water, together with drinking water, toilet and internet connection tables. Of 134,329 dwellings, 111,699 took electricity directly from EBS, 8,143 from government supply in the interior and 2,282 relied on their own generator. District results are in a separate volume, and a 10 percent census sample with household electricity, water supply, fuel, toilet, wall and roof variables can be tabulated by district on the REDATAM server. Format and access: free PDF volumes and free online processing. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0 (site-wide statement: content on statistics-suriname.org under CC BY 4.0 except where otherwise noted). Caveats: tables are in Dutch inside PDFs, the online base is a sample with weights, and a new census was under way in 2024. Simulation uses: electricity supply modes and generator dependence for interior electrification and resilience studies. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub and IPUMS International.
